astropy_separability_cstack_right_ndarra.title: astropy separability _cstack right ndarray patch applied
astropy_separability_cstack_right_ndarra.content: In this session, the separability_matrix bug for nested CompoundModels was reproduced in the container and traced to astropy/modeling/separable.py::_cstack. In the else-branch for a right operand that is already an ndarray coord matrix, the code incorrectly embedded a block of ones with `cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = 1`, which destroys separability information for nested compound models such as `m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & (m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5))`. A source patch was applied to preserve the nested coord matrix instead: `cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = right`. Next steps: rerun the reproducer in the docker testbed to confirm the expected matrix, then execute `./run_tests.sh` and continue iterating until the final VERDICT is RESOLVED.
